create_stacking_classifier: create a stacking classifier that combines multiple base estimators with a logistic regression final estimator
create_stacking_regressor: create a stacking regressor that stacks multiple base estimators with a RidgeCV final estimator
fit_stacking_model: fit a stacking classifier or regressor on training data with cross-validated base estimator predictions
predict_stacking_model: predict target values for new samples using a fitted stacking classifier or regressor
transform_stacking_model: transform input data into stacked base estimator predictions for use as final estimator features
